brief: A portable electronics organizer: a base with removable bins for small parts, at least one drawer, and a carry handle.

requirements.requirement: A base with removable bins for small parts
requirements.evidence: Hex base of full pieces at (-1,0), (0,0), (0,1), (1,1). Two removable bins: bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-div2 and bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-div3, each with compartments.

notch:0#-1,1#notch1, a notch drawer frame (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) between bases (-1,0) and (0,0). It is the drawer frame the configurator offered; I did not add a separate drawer body or confirm it pulls out.

No handle is on the build now. handle:0,1,0 was placed, then removed while I tried to replace the half base at (1,0) with a full one, which was refused (CAP_ON_FLAT). A handle needs its triangle of covers, including (1,0), so it cannot stay until that cell is rebuilt.
The configurator checks fit and collisions only; it does not verify weight, balance, or whether the plastic part is portable. The handle that would carry it is not present.

finish.summary: I built a partial organizer base and did not finish it. check_build reports ok with meshClash "clear". The current build has four full base cells (-1,0), (0,0), (0,1), (1,1), two removable bins, a notch drawer frame and covers. The cell (1,0) is empty because I removed its half-base to fix a loose joint, and the attempt to replace it was rolled back, so the carry handle that was on the (0,1) cover is gone. One open cap face (1,1;*;90) is reported as info only. The build is not in the intended final state.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.use: A bar standing off the flat with room for a hand behind it, for a cell or a column that gets moved by its side rather than its top.
